title: Interviews & Statements (Ethical, High-Level)

principles.title: Memory and Recall Limits
points: Stress can narrow attention and distort time perception
Memory is reconstructive; confidence is not accuracy

principles.title: Cognitive Interview (Conceptual)
principles.purpose: Improve recall without suggestion by altering retrieval cues.
components: Multiple retrieval routes (time, perspective) without coercion
quality_controls: Avoid introducing new facts in questions

principles.title: Statement Quality Checklist
checks: Time markers: calls, texts, receipts, logs

practice_prompts: Which details are direct observation vs interpretation?
What independent sources could corroborate timeline details?
Where might a leading prompt have influenced an answer?
